items.title: Higher Rates Are Testing Philip Morris Stock and Other Dividend Defensives
items.summary: Fed officials are again talking tough on inflation, and markets are taking them at their word. Higher for longer rates can punish richly priced growth stories, yet often leave more defensive, dividend-paying value stocks coming under fresh scrutiny from investors hunting for resilience and income. This article examines what that shift may mean and walks through three stocks exposed to this latest Fed rhetoric from our higher-rate-focused screener.
